senses.en: (of a molecule) consisting of two atoms

ex.en: Oxygen gas is a diatomic molecule made of two oxygen atoms.
ex.zh: 氧氣是由兩個氧原子組成的雙原子分子。

root.note: 兩個原子的 → 雙原子的

senses.en: a bitter, forceful verbal attack or criticism

ex.en: The coach launched into a diatribe against the referees.
ex.zh: 教練開始對裁判大肆抨擊。

root.note: 原指消磨時間的講論，後指冗長的抨擊

senses.en: a formal pronouncement from an authority
a short statement expressing a general truth

ex.en: The old dictum "less is more" guides her design style.
ex.zh: 「少即是多」這句老格言引導著她的設計風格。

root.note: 被說出來的話 → 格言、宣告

senses.en: intended to teach, especially a moral lesson
in the manner of a teacher, often in a way that is preachy

ex.en: The fable is didactic, ending with a clear lesson about honesty.
ex.zh: 這則寓言帶有教化意味，結尾明確點出誠實的道理。

root.note: 用來教導的 → 教誨的

senses.en: a way in which things are not the same
the amount left when one number is subtracted from another
a disagreement

ex.en: Can you spot the difference between these two pictures?
ex.zh: 你看得出這兩張圖片的不同之處嗎？

root.note: 往不同方向帶開 → 差異

senses.en: (logic) a characteristic that distinguishes one species from others of the same genus

ex.en: In Aristotle's definition, "rational" is the differentia that separates humans from other animals.
ex.zh: 在亞里斯多德的定義中，「理性」是區分人類與其他動物的種差。

root.note: 把事物區分開的特徵 → 種差

senses.en: showing or depending on a difference; varying by circumstances
a difference in amount between comparable things
a gear that lets a vehicle's wheels turn at different speeds

ex.en: The pay differential between men and women remains a concern.
ex.zh: 男女之間的薪資差距仍是令人關注的問題。

root.note: 有區別的 → 差別的

senses.en: to recognize or show the difference between things
to make something different or distinct

ex.en: Young children often cannot differentiate between fantasy and reality.
ex.zh: 年幼的孩子常常分不清幻想和現實。

root.note: 把事物區分開來 → 區分

senses.en: shyness caused by a lack of self-confidence

ex.en: His diffidence made him hesitate to speak up in meetings.
ex.zh: 他缺乏自信，因此在會議上不太敢發言。

root.note: 不信任自己 → 缺乏自信

senses.en: modest or shy because of a lack of self-confidence

ex.en: The diffident new student barely spoke during her first week.
ex.zh: 那位羞怯的新同學第一週幾乎沒開口說話。

root.note: 不信任自己的 → 缺乏自信的

mn: diffident（不自信）和 confident（自信）是同字根 fid 的反義詞。

senses.en: able to spread out or be diffused

ex.en: Small, diffusible molecules pass easily through the cell membrane.
ex.zh: 小而可擴散的分子能輕易穿過細胞膜。

root.note: 能向四處倒出、流散的 → 可擴散的

senses.en: the spreading of something more widely
(science) the movement of particles from higher to lower concentration

ex.en: The printing press sped up the diffusion of new ideas across Europe.
ex.zh: 印刷術加快了新思想在歐洲的傳播。

root.note: 向四處流散 → 擴散

senses.en: a person of high rank or office

ex.en: Each foreign dignitary was greeted at the airport by the mayor.
ex.zh: 每位外國貴賓都由市長在機場親自迎接。

root.note: 尊貴的人 → 顯要人物

senses.en: a pair of letters representing one sound, such as "ph" or "sh"
senses.zh: 二合字母（兩個字母發一個音）

ex.en: The letters "th" form a digraph in the word "think."
ex.zh: 在 think 這個字中，th 是一個二合字母。

root.note: 兩個寫出的字母 → 二合字母

senses.en: to leave the main subject temporarily in speech or writing

ex.en: Let me digress for a moment to tell you a funny story.
ex.zh: 讓我稍微離題一下，跟你們說個有趣的故事。

root.note: 走開、離開主路 → 離題

senses.en: to make or become wider or larger
to speak or write at length (dilate on)

ex.en: Your pupils dilate when you walk into a dark room.
ex.zh: 當你走進暗室時，瞳孔會放大。

root.note: 向外張開變寬 → 擴張

senses.en: slow to act; intended to cause delay

ex.en: The lawyer used dilatory tactics to postpone the trial.
ex.zh: 律師用拖延戰術來延後審判。

parts.m: carry, put off 帶走、延後

root.note: 把事情往後推延的 → 拖延的

mn: 不要和 dilate（擴張）搞混：dilatory 與 delay 意思相近。

senses.en: a situation requiring a difficult choice between two options

ex.en: She faced a dilemma: tell the truth or protect her friend.
ex.zh: 她陷入兩難：說出實話，還是保護朋友。

root.note: 兩個前提 → 兩難

senses.en: a person who dabbles in an art or field without real commitment or knowledge

ex.en: Real painters dismissed him as a dilettante who painted only on weekends.
ex.zh: 真正的畫家們把他當成只在週末作畫的半吊子。

parts.m: delight 使愉快（義大利文 dilettare）

root.note: 只為取樂而涉獵的人 → 業餘愛好者

senses.en: careful and persistent work or effort

ex.en: Her diligence paid off when she won a full scholarship.
ex.zh: 她的勤奮有了回報，贏得了全額獎學金。

root.note: 用心挑選、珍視 → 認真 → 勤勉

mn: due diligence：盡職調查（商業、法律常用）。

senses.en: to make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water
to make something weaker in force or effect
(of a liquid) weakened by adding water

ex.en: You should dilute the juice with water for young children.
ex.zh: 給幼童喝的果汁應該用水稀釋。

root.note: 洗開、沖淡 → 稀釋

senses.en: a reduction in size, amount, or importance

ex.en: Doctors noticed a steady diminution in the tumor's size.
ex.zh: 醫生注意到腫瘤的大小持續縮小。

root.note: 變小 → 減少

senses.en: with little light; not brightly
vaguely or faintly

ex.en: I only dimly remember the house where I was born.
ex.zh: 我只隱約記得我出生的那棟房子。

senses.en: a sound formed by combining two vowels in a single syllable, as in "coin"

ex.en: The vowel sound in "boy" is a diphthong.
ex.zh: boy 這個字裡的母音是一個雙母音。

root.note: 兩個聲音 → 雙母音

mn: 注意拼法有兩個 h：di-ph-th-ong；ph 唸作 [f]。

senses.en: the management of relations between countries
skill in dealing with people tactfully

ex.en: The conflict was finally settled through careful diplomacy.
ex.zh: 這場衝突最終透過謹慎的外交手段解決。

parts.m: double, folded 對折（希臘文 diploma 對折的文件）

root.note: 處理官方對折文書（國書）的事務 → 外交

senses.en: an official who represents a country abroad
a person who deals with others tactfully

ex.en: The diplomat worked for years to improve relations between the two nations.
ex.zh: 這位外交官花了多年時間改善兩國關係。

root.note: 持有官方文書的人 → 外交官

senses.en: relating to diplomacy
tactful in dealing with people

ex.en: She gave a diplomatic answer that did not offend anyone.
ex.zh: 她給了一個圓滑的回答，誰也沒得罪。

root.note: 與外交文書有關的 → 外交的、圓滑的

senses.en: a diplomat (dated)

ex.en: The old diplomatist had served at embassies on four continents.
ex.zh: 那位老外交官曾在四大洲的大使館任職。

root.note: 從事外交的人 → 外交官

senses.en: to have a different opinion
(of food or climate) to make someone feel unwell

ex.en: It is fine to disagree as long as we stay respectful.
ex.zh: 只要彼此保持尊重，意見不同是沒關係的。

root.note: 不同意

senses.en: to refuse to accept something as valid

ex.en: The referee may disallow the goal if a player was offside.
ex.zh: 如果有球員越位，裁判可能判進球無效。

root.note: 不允許 → 駁回

senses.en: to cease to be visible
to cease to exist

ex.en: Many local languages may disappear within a generation.
ex.zh: 許多地方語言可能在一個世代內消失。

root.note: 與出現相反 → 消失

senses.en: to fail to meet someone's hopes or expectations

ex.en: I promise I will not disappoint you this time.
ex.zh: 我保證這次不會讓你失望。

root.note: 原指撤除職位，引申為讓期待落空 → 使失望

senses.en: to have or express an unfavorable opinion
to officially refuse to agree to

ex.en: My parents disapprove of video games on school nights.
ex.zh: 我爸媽不贊成我在上學日的晚上打電動。

root.note: 不贊成

senses.en: to take weapons away from someone
to reduce a country's military forces
to make someone less hostile or suspicious; to charm
senses.zh: 使消除敵意；使卸下心防

ex.en: Her warm smile seemed to disarm even the angriest customers.
ex.zh: 她溫暖的笑容似乎連最生氣的客人都能讓他們消氣。

root.note: 去除武器 → 解除武裝；卸下心防

senses.en: to make untidy or disordered

ex.en: Please do not disarrange the books on the display table.
ex.zh: 請不要把展示桌上的書弄亂。

root.note: 與排列整齊相反 → 弄亂

senses.en: to deny any responsibility for or connection with

ex.en: The party was quick to disavow the candidate's offensive remarks.
ex.zh: 該黨迅速撇清與候選人冒犯性言論的關係。

root.note: 不承認 → 否認

senses.en: a denial of responsibility for or connection with something

ex.en: The company issued a public disavowal of the manager's comments.
ex.zh: 公司公開聲明與該經理的言論劃清界線。

root.note: 不承認 → 否認

senses.en: a person who refuses to believe something, especially religious claims

ex.en: Even a disbeliever had to admit the magic trick was impressive.
ex.zh: 就連不信邪的人也不得不承認那個魔術令人驚嘆。

root.note: 不相信的人

senses.en: to relieve of a burden or worry

ex.en: Talking to a counselor helped her disburden her mind of guilt.
ex.zh: 和輔導員談談幫助她卸下了心中的罪惡感。

root.note: 去除負擔 → 卸下重擔

senses.en: to pay out money from a fund

ex.en: The foundation will disburse the grants in early spring.
ex.zh: 基金會將於初春撥發補助款。

root.note: 從錢包裡拿出 → 支付

mn: burs 就是 purse（錢包）；reimburse（償還）也是同字根。

senses.en: to get rid of something as no longer useful
[ˋdɪskɑrd] something that has been thrown away

ex.en: Please discard any food that has passed its expiration date.
ex.zh: 請丟掉任何超過保存期限的食物。

root.note: 把手上的牌丟掉 → 丟棄

senses.en: able to be seen, noticed, or recognized

ex.en: There was no discernible difference between the two samples.
ex.zh: 兩個樣本之間看不出有任何差別。

root.note: 能夠分辨開來的 → 可辨別的

senses.en: a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosophy

ex.en: As a disciple of the famous chef, he learned every classic recipe.
ex.zh: 身為那位名廚的弟子，他學會了每一道經典食譜。

root.note: 學習的人 → 門徒

senses.en: concerning punishment for breaking rules
relating to an academic field

ex.en: The student faced disciplinary action for cheating on the exam.
ex.zh: 該學生因考試作弊而面臨懲處。

root.note: 與訓練、紀律有關的 → 懲戒的

senses.en: the practice of training people to obey rules; controlled behavior
a branch of knowledge
to punish or train someone to obey rules

ex.en: It takes discipline to practice the violin every day.
ex.zh: 每天練小提琴需要自律。

root.note: 學習與訓練 → 紀律；學問 → 學科

senses.en: to refuse to acknowledge or accept responsibility for

ex.en: The website tried to disclaim any responsibility for errors.
ex.zh: 這個網站試圖撇清對任何錯誤的責任。

root.note: 不主張 → 否認、放棄

senses.en: to change or spoil the color of something

ex.en: Strong sunlight can discolor wooden furniture over time.
ex.zh: 強烈的陽光久了會讓木製家具變色。

root.note: 破壞顏色 → 變色

senses.en: to make someone feel uneasy or embarrassed
to defeat or thwart (archaic)

ex.en: The reporter's pointed question seemed to discomfit the mayor.
ex.zh: 記者尖銳的問題似乎讓市長很窘迫。

parts.m: make, do 做（拉丁文 facere）

root.note: 把做好的事破壞掉 → 挫敗 → 使困窘

mn: 別和 discomfort 混淆：discomfit 是「使窘迫、挫敗」。

senses.en: slight pain or physical unease
a feeling of embarrassment or anxiety

ex.en: You may feel some discomfort after the injection.
ex.zh: 打針後你可能會感到有些不舒服。

root.note: 不舒適

senses.en: to break the connection of or between
a lack of connection or understanding between things

ex.en: Remember to disconnect the charger once the battery is full.
ex.zh: 電池充飽後記得拔掉充電器。

root.note: 與連在一起相反 → 斷開

senses.en: very unhappy and unable to be comforted
senses.zh: 極度沮喪的；無法安慰的

ex.en: The disconsolate child sat alone after losing his puppy.
ex.zh: 那個失去小狗的孩子傷心地獨自坐著，怎麼安慰都沒用。

root.note: 無法被安慰的 → 極度沮喪的

senses.en: the act of stopping or ending something

ex.en: Customers protested the discontinuance of the bus route.
ex.zh: 乘客們抗議該公車路線停駛。

root.note: 不再繼續 → 停止

senses.en: disagreement between people
a lack of harmony between musical notes

ex.en: The argument over money caused discord within the family.
ex.zh: 為錢的爭執造成家中不和。

root.note: 心不在一起 → 不和

senses.en: to refuse to approve of; to discourage
to disturb the composure of

ex.en: The school board chose to discountenance the use of phones in class.
ex.zh: 校董會決定不贊成在課堂上使用手機。

root.note: 不給好臉色 → 不贊成

senses.en: to find something unexpectedly or for the first time
to become aware of a fact

ex.en: Scientists hope to discover life on other planets.
ex.zh: 科學家希望能在其他行星上發現生命。

root.note: 掀開蓋子 → 發現

senses.en: to harm the good reputation of someone
to cause an idea or evidence to seem false
loss of reputation or respect

ex.en: The lawyer tried to discredit the witness by pointing out past lies.
ex.zh: 律師藉由指出證人過去的謊言，試圖讓其證詞不可信。

root.note: 使不被相信 → 使丟臉、使不可信

senses.en: careful in speech or action to avoid causing offense or revealing secrets
unobtrusive; not attracting attention

ex.en: Please be discreet and do not mention the surprise party.
ex.zh: 請保密，不要提起驚喜派對的事。

root.note: 能分辨輕重的 → 謹慎的

mn: discreet（謹慎的）vs. discrete（分離的、個別的），拼法相近，意思不同。

senses.en: showing a lack of agreement; inconsistent

ex.en: The two witnesses gave discrepant accounts of the accident.
ex.zh: 兩名證人對這起事故的說法不一致。

root.note: 發出不同的聲音 → 不一致的

senses.en: to treat people unfairly based on race, sex, age, etc.
to recognize a difference between things

ex.en: Employers must not discriminate against applicants because of their age.
ex.zh: 雇主不得因應徵者的年齡而歧視他們。

root.note: 分辨區別 → 區別對待 → 歧視

senses.en: moving from subject to subject; rambling
proceeding by reasoning rather than intuition

ex.en: His discursive lecture covered everything except the assigned topic.
ex.zh: 他那東拉西扯的講課，除了指定主題之外什麼都講了。

root.note: 到處亂跑的 → 散漫的

senses.en: the act of talking about something to reach a decision or exchange ideas

ex.en: We had a long discussion about climate change in class.
ex.zh: 我們在課堂上針對氣候變遷進行了很長的討論。

root.note: 把問題敲開、分析 → 討論

senses.en: to deprive someone of the right to vote or other rights

ex.en: Strict ID laws may disenfranchise elderly and poor voters.
ex.zh: 嚴格的身分證明法規可能會剝奪年長和貧窮選民的投票權。

root.note: 去除權利 → 剝奪選舉權

senses.en: to separate or release something from something else
to withdraw from involvement or combat

ex.en: Students who disengage from class often fall behind.
ex.zh: 上課不投入的學生往往會跟不上進度。

root.note: 與咬合、參與相反 → 脫離

senses.en: disapproval or dislike

ex.en: The old tradition has fallen into disfavor among young people.
ex.zh: 這項舊傳統已經不受年輕人青睞。

root.note: 不喜愛 → 不贊成、失寵

senses.en: to spoil the appearance of

ex.en: Graffiti can disfigure even the most beautiful building.
ex.zh: 塗鴉能毀掉即使是最美的建築外觀。

root.note: 破壞形狀 → 損毀外觀

senses.en: the state of being only partly or carelessly dressed

ex.en: The actor answered the door in dishabille, still wearing his robe.
ex.zh: 那位演員衣衫不整地來應門，身上還穿著浴袍。

root.note: 沒穿好衣服 → 衣衫不整

senses.en: not truthful; likely to lie, cheat, or steal

ex.en: It is dishonest to copy a classmate's homework.
ex.zh: 抄同學的作業是不誠實的行為。

root.note: 不誠實的

senses.en: to make someone realize that a belief is false, often causing disappointment
disappointment from discovering something is not as good as believed

ex.en: I hate to disillusion you, but the job is not as glamorous as it looks.
ex.zh: 我不想讓你失望，但這份工作沒有看起來那麼光鮮。

root.note: 去除幻想 → 幻滅

senses.en: to clean something with chemicals to destroy bacteria

ex.en: Nurses disinfect the equipment after every patient.
ex.zh: 護理師在每位病人使用後都會為器材消毒。

root.note: 去除感染源 → 消毒

senses.en: a chemical that destroys bacteria

ex.en: Wipe the counter with disinfectant after cutting raw meat.
ex.zh: 切完生肉後，要用消毒劑擦拭流理台。

root.note: 去除感染源的東西 → 消毒劑

senses.en: to prevent someone from inheriting one's property

ex.en: The wealthy father threatened to disinherit his son.
ex.zh: 那位有錢的父親揚言要剝奪兒子的繼承權。

root.note: 去除繼承權

senses.en: not influenced by personal advantage; impartial
not interested (informal usage, often considered incorrect)

ex.en: A disinterested judge should decide the case.
ex.zh: 這件案子應該由一位公正無私的法官來判決。

root.note: 不牽涉個人利益的 → 公正的

mn: SAT 常考：disinterested 是「公正無私」，uninterested 才是「不感興趣」。

senses.en: lacking connection; separating
(grammar) expressing a choice or contrast, as "or" or "but"

ex.en: The film's disjunctive editing jumps between three different decades.
ex.zh: 這部電影不連貫的剪輯在三個年代之間跳來跳去。

root.note: 不連接的 → 分離的

senses.en: to move a bone out of its normal position in a joint
to disturb the normal order or position of something

ex.en: He fell off his bike and managed to dislocate his shoulder.
ex.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來，肩膀脫臼了。

root.note: 離開原位 → 脫臼、擾亂

senses.en: the act of ordering someone to leave a job
the act of treating something as unworthy of consideration

ex.en: The worker sued the company over his unfair dismissal.
ex.zh: 那名員工因遭不當解雇而控告公司。

root.note: 送走 → 解雇、駁回

senses.en: to get off a horse or bicycle
to remove something from its support

ex.en: Riders must dismount and walk their bikes across the bridge.
ex.zh: 騎士必須下車，牽著腳踏車走過橋。

root.note: 與騎上相反 → 下馬

senses.en: failure or refusal to obey rules or authority

ex.en: Civil disobedience was a key strategy of the civil rights movement.
ex.zh: 公民不服從是民權運動的一項重要策略。

root.note: 不服從

senses.en: refusing or failing to obey

ex.en: The disobedient puppy kept chewing the furniture.
ex.zh: 那隻不聽話的小狗一直咬家具。

root.note: 不服從的

senses.en: to refuse to acknowledge any connection with someone or something

ex.en: His parents threatened to disown him if he dropped out of school.
ex.zh: 他父母揚言，如果他輟學就要跟他斷絕關係。

root.note: 不承認是自己的 → 斷絕關係

senses.en: a great difference, often an unfair one

ex.en: The report highlights the disparity between rich and poor neighborhoods.
ex.zh: 這份報告凸顯了富裕與貧窮社區之間的差距。

root.note: 不相等 → 差距

senses.en: to make a doubt, feeling, or belief disappear

ex.en: The scientist hoped to dispel common myths about vaccines.
ex.zh: 這位科學家希望能破除關於疫苗的常見迷思。

root.note: 驅趕走 → 驅散

senses.en: special permission to be exempt from a rule
the act of distributing something
a system or order prevailing at a particular time

ex.en: The athlete received a special dispensation to miss the final exam.
ex.zh: 這名運動員獲得特許，可以不參加期末考。

root.note: 秤好分發出去 → 分配；對規定的特別分配 → 特許

senses.en: to take the place of; to replace
to force people to leave their home
to move something from its usual position

ex.en: Robots may displace many factory workers in the coming decades.
ex.zh: 未來幾十年，機器人可能會取代許多工廠工人。

root.note: 離開原位置 → 取代、使流離失所

senses.en: to take land, property, or possessions away from someone

ex.en: The new law allowed the state to dispossess farmers of their land.
ex.zh: 新法允許政府剝奪農民的土地。

root.note: 去除擁有權 → 剝奪

senses.en: formal debate or argument

ex.en: Medieval students trained in public disputation on philosophy.
ex.zh: 中世紀的學生透過公開的哲學辯論來接受訓練。

root.note: 各自思考、提出不同想法 → 辯論

senses.en: to exclude someone from an activity for breaking a rule
to make someone unsuitable for a position

ex.en: A false start will disqualify a runner from the race.
ex.zh: 偷跑會讓跑者失去比賽資格。

root.note: 去除資格

senses.en: a feeling of worry or unease
to make someone worried or uneasy

ex.en: There is growing disquiet among parents about the new policy.
ex.zh: 家長們對新政策的憂慮日益加深。

root.note: 不平靜 → 不安

senses.en: to pay no attention to; to ignore
the act of ignoring something

ex.en: Drivers who disregard the speed limit put everyone at risk.
ex.zh: 無視速限的駕駛會讓所有人陷入危險。

root.note: 不注意 → 忽視

senses.en: not considered respectable in character or appearance

ex.en: He lost money by investing with a disreputable company.
ex.zh: 他投資了一家名聲不佳的公司，結果賠了錢。

root.note: 不被人看好的 → 名聲不好的

senses.en: the state of having a bad reputation

ex.en: The cheating scandal brought the whole sport into disrepute.
ex.zh: 這起作弊醜聞讓整個運動項目聲名狼藉。

root.note: 失去好名聲 → 不名譽

senses.en: to take off one's clothes; to undress

ex.en: Patients are asked to disrobe and put on a hospital gown.
ex.zh: 病人被要求脫掉衣服，換上病人服。

root.note: 脫下袍子 → 脫衣服

senses.en: to interrupt an activity or process by causing disorder
to radically change an industry or market with a new approach

ex.en: The storm could disrupt train service for several days.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雨可能讓火車停駛好幾天。

root.note: 破開 → 擾亂、中斷

senses.en: to fail to satisfy; to make discontented

ex.en: Long waiting times will dissatisfy even loyal customers.
ex.zh: 漫長的等待時間會讓即使是忠實的顧客也不滿意。

root.note: 不使滿足 → 使不滿

senses.en: to cut up a body or plant to study its parts
to analyze something in great detail

ex.en: In biology class, we had to dissect a frog.
ex.zh: 在生物課上，我們必須解剖一隻青蛙。

root.note: 切開 → 解剖

senses.en: the cutting up of a body or plant to study it
a detailed analysis

ex.en: The article offers a careful dissection of the election results.
ex.zh: 這篇文章對選舉結果做了細緻的剖析。

root.note: 切開 → 解剖、剖析

senses.en: to hide one's true feelings, motives, or beliefs

ex.en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment with a smile.
ex.zh: 她試著用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

root.note: 表現得和真實不相似 → 掩飾

mn: dissemble（掩飾）vs. disassemble（拆解）vs. resemble（相似）。

senses.en: to spread information or ideas widely

ex.en: Social media can disseminate news faster than any newspaper.
ex.zh: 社群媒體傳播新聞的速度比任何報紙都快。

root.note: 把種子撒開 → 散播

senses.en: disagreement that leads to discord

ex.en: The budget cuts created dissension among the staff.
ex.zh: 預算刪減在員工之間造成了不和。

root.note: 感覺各不相同 → 意見分歧

senses.en: the expression of disagreement with official views
to express disagreement with a prevailing opinion

ex.en: In a democracy, citizens have the right to dissent.
ex.zh: 在民主國家，公民有表達異議的權利。

root.note: 感覺不同 → 異議

mn: dissent（異議）的反義詞是 assent（同意）；別和 descent（下降）搞混。

senses.en: disagreeing with the majority or official view
a person who disagrees

ex.en: Only one dissentient voice was heard during the vote.
ex.zh: 表決時只有一個反對的聲音。

root.note: 感覺不同的 → 持異議的
